prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi-statue demi statue portrait, five-material body (asymmetric), every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in Yoruba bridal makeup — rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big gold hoop with a red-enamel bead.

Physique: A colossal rounded chest, an enormous belly of massive rounded folds hanging low and heavy, no waist at all, her left arm crystal, her right arm carved stone, her torso a glass vessel, her thigh-stubs vessel and wood.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent amethyst crystal, one continuous carved mass, never hollow. Light passes straight through it. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid polished black obsidian with faint internal swirls, completely opaque, completely opaque. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (chest, belly, hips): a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled completely to the brim with clear clear coral-pink water with drifting light, no hollow space, no air gap. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through it, rising to the collarbone line itself.

Left thigh (hip to tip): a small sculpted vessel of clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled with clear sapphire-blue water with drifting stars. A little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her left thigh curves inward and seals shut into its own small, smooth, rounded, closed tip — the vessel simply reaching its natural end there. Right thigh (hip to tip): carved from ONE solid block of dark wenge wood with fine gold-tan pinstripes, completely opaque, completely opaque. A little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her right thigh curves inward and rounds off into its own small, smooth, satin-polished carved tip — the wood simply reaching its natural end there.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a warm golden amber on one side and a deep charcoal grey on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so amber light glances off one side and grey light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
